releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.36
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.36**: 6 changes since 0.1.35.

- Make phone questions readable and touchable (#2636)
- Apply defaults.clipboard-write to pane osc 52 writes (#2638)
- Drop a terminal on a pane to make it a tab of that split (#2635)
- Tabs inside a split: ⌘⇧←/→, a 2/3 badge, hidden tabs kept warm (#2628)
- Draw Kitty images, with one upload per image change (#2618)
- Clients carry slot tabs, and phux slot add|out|next|prev (#2622)
